title: Customer Support Team Lead
description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role:

Worker Operations is the team that owns end-to-end operations and support for the supply-side (the workers) of our marketplace. We are over 200 team members who serve the 400,000+ (and growing) active professionals on our marketplace. As a Worker Operations Team Lead your primary role is to be an exceptional coach for your team.

Your responsibility is to provide agents with constructive feedback, identify the root causes of performance issues, and train them to address and correct those problems. You maintain high standards for your team and aren’t afraid to say, “This needs improvement, and here’s why.” You ensure that the customer experience remains the focal point of every discussion, set SMART goals for performance improvement, and deliver feedback that aligns with our standards. You’re also hands-on, willing to dive into customer issues directly, and you become a product expert so that you can coach your agents effectively.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:

- Closely monitoring agent performance, primarily in terms of quality, productivity, and attendance metrics, with a primary goal of maintaining quality assurance scores above 90%

- Providing frequent coaching to agents based QA feedback, metrics, customer survey responses, and your own ticket observations

- Occasionally handling angry customer escalations

- Ensure schedule adherence by agents and desired productivity levels

- Maintaining coaching logs and providing regular written feedback to agents

- Comfortably navigate our support environment, which includes tools such as Zendesk, Metabase, and Amazon Connect

- Listen to team members’ feedback and resolve any challenges or conflicts

- Initiate consequence management steps in the case of low-performing team members

- Delegate tasks to high potential team members to build a culture of learning and development in the team

- Suggest and lead team building activities for team motivation

EXPERIENCE

- 2+ years of coaching experience - Demonstrated success coaching individuals through structured feedback, development planning, and performance improvement.

- 2+ years of people management experience - Experience leading customer support teams, driving performance, engagement, and accountability.

- 2+ years of customer support experience - Strong foundation in delivering exceptional customer service and resolving complex customer issues.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN WORKER OPERATIONS

- Customer obsessed - Puts workers at the centre of every decision and consistently delivers a world-class experience.

- Data-driven problem solver - Uses data, trends, and root cause analysis to identify issues and deliver sustainable improvements.

- Thrives in ambiguity - Adapts quickly to changing priorities, products, and processes while maintaining high performance.

- Communicates with clarity - Shares information proactively, aligns stakeholders, and provides clear, actionable feedback.

- Bias for action - Takes ownership, moves with urgency, and focuses on delivering outcomes over perfection.

- Continuously learns - Quickly develops expertise in new tools, products, and processes, applying that knowledge to improv

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist At INTEGRITYOne Partners (IOP), we are a federal technology company focused on DevSecOps and agile software development, analytics and AI, cloud engineering, and data management. Our people are known for being technical Swiss army knives that are depended on by our clients to support a myriad of highly complex, technical problems within rapidly changing missions. We enable federal law enforcement clients to execute high-tempo, mission-critical work that ultimately improves the lives of the people they serve. Our culture is entrepreneurial, mission-first, and meritocratic, giving you direct access to decision-makers and real influence over how we win and deliver.

Job Description
INTEGRITYOne Partners is seeking a motivated, resourceful, and self-starting Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for full-cycle recruiting activities supporting current program needs, strategic growth initiatives, and proposal efforts within the federal government contracting space. This person will report directly to the Manager of People Operations.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships with technical professionals, and can effectively partner with hiring managers to attract and hire top talent. This individual will play a key role in supporting IOP's continued growth by identifying exceptional candidates, delivering a positive candidate experience, and helping build high-performing teams that support mission-critical government programs.

Location This position is remote; however, candidates located in Maryland, Washington, D.C., or Virginia are preferred.

• Conduct candidate screenings, interviews, and assessments to evaluate qualifications, experience, and overall fit.

• Coordinate and facilitate interviews while ensuring efficient and positive candidate experience.

Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

• Build and maintain pipelines of cleared technical talent for current and future hiring needs.

• Proactively engage passive candidates and cultivate long-term relationships within targeted talent communities.

• Leverage LinkedIn, JazzHR, professional networks, employee referrals, and other creative sourcing channels to identify qualified cleared talent.

Recruiting Operations & Process Improvement

• Identify, engage, and maintain relationships with contingent candidates to support proposal submissions, anticipated contract awards, and future staffing needs.

• Stay informed on market trends, compensation considerations, security clearance requirements, and emerging recruiting best practices within the federal contracting industry.

title: Technical Account Executive
description:
About FirstPrinciples

FirstPrinciples is a research company building AI for scientific discovery. It began with Theo, the AI Physicist, and has since grown into a product-focused company with two additional systems including Theo Conjecture, built for automated conjecturing, and Theo Collaborator, an adaptive environment for doing complex research with AI.

 

We're a fast-growing, remote-first team of builders, researchers, engineers, and thinkers working across Canada, the US, the UK, and expanding globally. What brings us together is a shared curiosity about how the universe works, and a belief that we can build systems that help us explore it more effectively.

 

We spend our time working on questions that don't have clear answers, like how to design AI that can reason through scientific problems, and how the scientific process as a whole might evolve. This is work that sits somewhere between creativity and rigorous thinking, and often requires comfort with ambiguity and iteration. If you're someone who enjoys tackling big, abstract problems and exploring ideas that don't yet have a defined path forward, you'll likely find the work here interesting.

Why This Role Exists:

We’re building products to accelerate progress in physics - but that only matters if the right researchers discover them, understand how they work, and make the decision to adopt them. Besides building the technology, the challenge is earning the trust of researchers and institutions, and translating it into active usage and commercial relationships.

This role exists to lead that journey. You’ll work across the full sales lifecycle: from identifying and reaching out to researchers and organizations, to discovery, demos, evaluations, and close. You’ll help prospective users move from curiosity, to confidence that the platform can advance their research.

Your impact will directly shape who we serve, how we bring the product to market, and how quickly we build a repeatable path to adoption and revenue.

What You’ll Do

- Rapidly develop fluency in customers’ technical domains, research programs, and scientific problems to identify where FirstPrinciples can create value

- Prepare highly targeted account strategies and outreach based on a genuine understanding of the organization and its work

- Build relationships and pipeline across commercial R&D teams, industry researchers, research groups, national laboratories, and other research-intensive organizations

- Own the end-to-end commercial lifecycle: from prospecting and qualification, to discovery, demos, proposals, and close

- Run technically credible discovery conversations and product demos that connect researchers’ goals to concrete product use cases

- Help prospective customers structure pilot plans, establish success criteria, and build confidence in adopting the platform

- Navigate multiple stakeholders across scientific, technical, administrative, procurement, and leadership functions

- Partner closely with Research Partners throughout discovery, evaluation, onboarding, and expansion

- Bring market feedback, objections, and emerging use cases back to product, research, and engineering

- Build lightweight systems for outreach, qualification, account planning, CRM management, follow-up, and forecasting that can scale with the organization

- Own clear pipeline, conversion, and revenue goals while helping define our early sales playbook

Who You Are

- Exceptionally curious and analytical, with the ability to rapidly develop fluency in unfamiliar technical and scientific domains

- High agency and learning velocity; you’re comfortable being dropped into a complex topic, figuring it out quickly, and operating without an established playbook

- Able to form strong, testable points of view from incomplete information, grounded in first-principles reasoning rather than defaulting to established frameworks

As a Client Success Specialist within the Customer Success team, this role is crucial in ensuring customers attain their desired outcomes using our product or service. This responsibility is pivotal for enhancing customer satisfaction and retention. You will act as an essential bridge between our company and its customers, championing customer success and satisfaction. Additionally, the duties shall include conducting legal research, drafting legal documents, and offering support on legal matters, contributing significantly to our overall service quality.

Customer Service

• You’ll be receiving requests from users and leads, asking questions about the services we offer and how to manage their Codekeeper account

Tech Setup Support

Sales Support

Report Drafting

• Analytical thinking, and a proactive attitude

•
Lead the design of secure systems, networks and applications across on-premise, cloud and hybrid environments

•

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll guide customers from contract signature through setup, go-live, and their first audit milestone. Success here means customers complete setup, reach value sooner, and trust Sprinto to help them make progress. As you grow, you’ll take on more customer journeys and more complex decisions.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

This role may suit you if you have a B.Tech background in cybersecurity or a related technical field with meaningful security exposure , or an MBA in Information Technology Business Management (ITBM) . There is no graduation-year requirement . Internships, projects, and early work experience all count.

We’ll look for evidence that you can:

title: Delivery Lead
description:
About the Team

Our strategic customers are increasingly running multiple deployment workstreams at once across areas such as Frontier, workforce intelligence, software engineering, cybersecurity, AI infrastructure, and AI distribution.

The Delivery Lead is deployed selectively when a strategic customer has multiple materially interdependent delivery workstreams and no single workstream owner can resolve the dependencies between them. The Account Director (AD) continues to own account strategy, executive relationships, commercial outcomes, and use-case prioritization; technical delivery owners own solution design and execution within each workstream. The Delivery Lead owns the cross-workstream delivery contract-the integrated critical path, shared dependencies, program-level launch gates, resource conflicts, and time-bound escalation-and has delegated authority to drive those decisions.

This is a senior delivery leadership role for someone who can make program-level tradeoffs, turn cross-workstream ambiguity into decisions, and protect the integrated critical path without absorbing the AD’s or technical delivery owners’ accountability. It is not a general account-advisory or coordination role.

About the Role

The Account Director (AD) owns account strategy, executive relationships, the commercial plan, use-case selection and prioritization, and the customer-outcome narrative. Technical delivery owners own solution design and execution within individual workstreams. The Delivery Lead is assigned only when multiple workstreams have material dependencies and owns the program-level critical path, cross-workstream sequencing, integrated launch gates, resource-contention decisions, and delivery-risk escalation.

Within the agreed scope, the Delivery Lead has delegated authority to require a decision, set program milestones, re-sequence dependent work, and call a readiness hold. Changes to customer priority, use-case scope, or commercial commitments return to the AD; technical decisions remain with the technical delivery owner. The Delivery Lead does not create a second customer success plan, own individual use cases, manage technical resources day to day, or sit between the customer and the teams doing the work.

Success is measured by the time required to resolve cross-workstream blockers, schedule predictability, integrated launch readiness, and clean handoffs-not by the number of meetings, status artifacts, or resources coordinated. The Delivery Lead stands down or hands off program-level governance once cross-workstream dependencies no longer require a dedicated owner.

In this role, you will:

- Own the cross-workstream delivery contract for designated multi-workstream programs, including the integrated critical path, shared dependencies, program-level commitments, decision owners, and launch gates.

- Set the integrated critical path and program milestones, while leaving solution design and workstream execution with the relevant technical delivery owners.

- Secure named decision owners and time-bound resolution for cross-workstream blockers before they become executive surprises.

- Drive cross-workstream sequencing and capacity tradeoffs within the agreed scope; return changes to customer priority, use-case scope, or commercial commitments to the Account Director, and technical decisions to the relevant technical owner.

- Run one program-level decision and dependency cadence that consumes, rather than duplicates, account and individual workstream cadences.

- Resolve cross-workstream resource conflicts with functional leaders; staffing and day-to-day direction within each workstream remain with the relevant functional or technical owner.

- Translate the customer priorities and outcomes agreed by the Account Director into program-level acceptance criteria, and provide delivery evidence back to the account team.

- Define and enforce integrated launch and handoff gates, including the authority to call a readiness hold whe

title: Quality Analyst - French (M/F)

tags: Hardware Platform : Hardware Test Operations : Test & Evaluation
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are looking for an Associate to join our rapidly growing Field Operations team in Atlanta, GA. The role of the Field Operations Associate is a critical part of ensuring our hardware is in a constant state of readiness to ensure the success of our test and evaluation (T&E) and deployment operations. This Associate will oversee a fleet of RC planes that act as surrogates for our Altius fleet. 

This role will ensure timely maintenance and preparedness, as well as operations in support of Test & Evaluation (T&E) operations. Additionally, this role will support surrogate flight ops for T&E events both in Atlanta and our field test sites and support Anduril’s strategy to deliver hardware and software to our customers where it is both mission critical and challenging.

This will require a breadth of understanding RC piloting and maintenance, the ability to work across teams seamlessly, a deep appreciation for details, and the ability to learn new subject matters quickly. As you execute surrogate T&E ops for our customers and team members, you have the unique opportunity to improve and grow our T&E and deployment capabilities. You will be charged with helping Anduril teams solve exceptional challenges, unblocking issues, and establishing procedures, all with the intention of making sure our customers missions are being met.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Collaborate with operations partners, business leaders, and external stakeholders to ensure the readiness and accountability of RC surrogate fleet

• Collaborate with your Test and Evaluation partners to ensure that the RC surrogate fleet is constantly test-ready

• Ensure the reordering, replacement, or repair of assigned equipment

• End-to-end movement of vehicles and equipment for all demos, deployments, and exercises

• Coordinate with Flight Test Engineers to assist with test planning

• Ensure RC fleet, personal operations, and surrogate operations are in compliance with FAA regulations

• Provide feedback to Engineering and T&E teams on surrogate ops will serve as critical input for their continuous improvement loop

• Maintain records of both maintenance and operator training and provide general administrative support to internal and external stakeholders

• Respond to stakeholder inquiries and complaints, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring needs are met regarding surrogate fleet availability and operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BA/BS preferred

• At least 3 years of RC flight experience on fixed wing, as well as accompanying maintenance operations

• FAA Part 107

• FAA Part 61 ground school complete (preferred)

• Experience collaborating cross functionally working towards a common goal

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritization, and planning

• Basic efficiency with office related computer applications

• Experience with scheduling and maintenance processes

• Highly polished communication skills

• US Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data

• This job will include travel up to 50%

US Salary Range
$86,000 — $112,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salar

title: Territory Sales Manager- Mid-Atlantic Region (Ashland City, TN, US, 37015)
description:
Company / Location Information

A.O. Smith is a global leader applying innovative technologies and energy-efficient solutions to products manufactured and marketed worldwide. The company is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of residential and commercial water heating equipment and boilers, as well as a manufacturer of water treatment products for residential and light commercial applications. A. O. Smith is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with approximately 12,000 employees at operations in the United States, Canada, China, India, Mexico, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom.

Primary Function

This is a Remote position based out of the Mid Atlantic Region. Applicants must be based out of one of the following states: New Jersey, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, West Virginia, Kentucky.

The Territory Sales Manager will be responsible for developing, implementing, managing, and maintaining the business plan and sales strategies for our premium line of high efficiency water heating products within their assigned area. This role involves managing the activities of the Representative Agencies within the territory, and direct contact with various plumbing industry related customers, shows, and events. The candidate will collaborate with the National Sales Manager and Regional Sales Managers to create and execute strategies to drive specification, adoption, and sales of high efficiency water heating products, with a primary focus on Heat Pump, Condensing Tank, and Tankless technologies. The customer base will encompass Large and Small Plumbing and HVAC Contractors, Private Equity Contractors, Contractor Groups and Associations, National to Custom Home Builders, local and national Distribution companies, and others. The position requires managing existing and established territories and accounts, while driving growth and market share acquisition.

• Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan in collaboration with National and Regional Management Team, outlining key objectives, target markets, and tactics to implement and monitor sales strategies to ensure alignment, effectiveness, and efficiency within Territory, Region, and Super Region.

• Coordinate with National and Regional Manager while working in tandem with Representative Agencies Sales Teams to execute tactical plans daily, calling upon groups with focus upon Residential New Construction and Repair and Remodel Contractors.

• Develop, Implement, Measure, and Report High Efficiency Product Specification, Installation, Repair, and Sales Training Programs to drive adoption of Heat Pump, Condensing Tank, and Tankless water heating technologies.

• Develop, implement, and monitor sales targets to lead Representative Agency members to achieve goals through tactical plan implementation.

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the territory to expand market sales and share through relationships, tools, and technologies including Dodge or other information service platforms.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, distribution branch teams and contractors to maximize sales opportunities and customer loyalty.

• Measure training and results by customer to ensure adoption, specification, knowledge base, and product market share position.

• Monitor, analyze, and share performance metrics to develop plan improvements.

• Research and identify new potential customers and market opportunities.

• Provide timely and effective solutions aligned with customer needs.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Product Development to ensure brand consistency and customer requirements.

• Remain updated on new product launches, competitors, and industry trends, ensuring the Sales team remains informed.

• Prepare quarterly and annual sales reviews and forecasts.

• 5+ years of Sales experience

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

• Proven record of exceeding sales targets

title: Google Cloud Certified Professionals
description:
This is a remote position.

Comerit is searching for Google Cloud Certified Professionals! As the market is growing in the Google Cloud space, so are the number of projects for Comerit that are Google Cloud Platform based. Specifically as we specialize in Data Transformation and Analytics, we would also prefer consultants with (GCP) BigQuery experience.

Although your GCP BigQuery experience may vary depending on the specific role and responsibilities assigned. However, here are some aspects of your BigQuery experience that may be relevant:

• Querying and Analysis: Writing SQL-like queries to extract insights from large datasets stored in BigQuery. This involves understanding the data schema, performing complex aggregations, joins, and transformations, and optimizing queries for performance.

• Data Loading and Extraction: Importing data from various sources into BigQuery, including files from Cloud Storage, streaming data from Pub/Sub, or data transfer from external systems. Similarly, exporting data from BigQuery to external destinations.

• Data Transformation: Performing data preprocessing and transformation tasks using BigQuery's powerful SQL capabilities. This may involve data cleaning, normalization, denormalization, and creating derived tables or views.

• Data Modeling and Schema Design: Designing and maintaining logical data models and schemas within BigQuery. This includes defining tables, partitions, and clustering strategies to optimize data storage and query performance.

• Performance Optimization: Analyzing query execution plans, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing query performance through techniques like partition pruning, caching, and query tuning.

• Integration and Automation: Collaborating with other GCP services, such as Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, or Data Studio, to build end-to-end data pipelines or integrate BigQuery with other systems. Automating job execution using scheduling tools or workflow frameworks like Cloud Composer or Cloud Data Fusion.

• Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Monitoring the performance and health of BigQuery jobs, identifying and resolving issues related to data ingestion, query performance, or data consistency. Utilizing monitoring tools, logging, and error handling mechanisms.

• Security and Compliance: Implementing appropriate security measures to protect sensitive data within BigQuery, adhering to data governance policies and compliance regulations. Managing access controls, data encryption, and auditing.

• Documentation and Collaboration: Maintaining documentation, including data dictionaries, process flows, and technical specifications. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

• Continuous Improvement: Staying up-to-date with the latest features and enhancements in BigQuery and related GCP services. Actively exploring opportunities to optimize data processing pipelines, enhance performance, and reduce costs.

If you are a Google Cloud Certified Professional, please apply and register.
Requirements

Any one of the following Google Cloud Platform Certifications:

• Professional Cloud Architect Certification

• Professional Data Engineer Certification

• Professional Cloud Developer Certification

• Professional Cloud Network Engineer Certification

• Professional Cloud Security Engineer Certification

• Professional Collaboration Engineer Certification

• Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer

• Google Cloud Certified Fellow: Hybrid Multi-Cloud

• Professional Machine Learning Engineer

title: Payment Integrity Program Development Senior Manager – Clinical & Facility Speci
description:
Job Description
A bit about this role:
As our Senior Payment Integrity Program Development Manager, you will serve as the primary clinical architect and inventor behind Devoted’s clinical claim edit and audit pipeline. Operating in a high-autonomy, outcomes-driven individual contributor role, you will conduct independent clinical research, interpret specialty society guidelines, and analyze multi-setting billing data to originate brand-new, automated payment integrity logic from scratch.
While complex, high-dollar inpatient care forms a critical foundation of this role, you will also apply your clinical acumen across outpatient, Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC), and professional settings to ensure a continuous, high-impact pipeline of payment integrity concepts.
Your responsibilities and impact will include:

• Greenfield Concept Ideation: Drive ground-up innovation by researching clinical literature, specialty society guidelines, and multi-setting billing trends (Inpatient, Outpatient, ASC, and Professional) to identify hidden payment anomalies and formulate original edit hypotheses.

• Primary Logic Architecture: Author end-to-end logics from scratch. Translate raw clinical documentation, medical policies, and facility/professional coding frameworks (MS-DRG, APR-DRG, APC/OPPS, ASC packaging, and CPT/HCPCS rules) into precise, automated logic parameters.

• Data Hypothesis Validation: Perform primary data analysis (utilizing modern AI tools for SQL query generation) to test your clinical hypotheses across clinical settings, prove financial viability on real-world datasets, and design parameters that prevent provider abrasion.

• Cross-Functional Policy Leadership: Pitch your original clinical concepts to directors and executive stakeholders; drive consensus across Clinical Operations, SIU, Claims, and Legal to approve novel policy interpretations and rule architectures.

• End-to-End Concept Ownership: Lead multi-phased concept rollouts across clinical settings-from initial clinical discovery through selection criteria, logic testing, post-launch tuning, and long-term performance tracking.

Required skills and experience:

• Clinical & Coding Credentials: An active Registered Nurse (RN) license with direct inpatient clinical experience (e.g., ICU, Med-Surg) AND an active professional coding certification (e.g., CPC, CCS, CCS-P, or RHIA).

• Net-New Concept Authoring: 5+ years of experience in payment integrity where you were the primary author and creator of net-new claim edits within a health plan or vendor setting (as opposed to evaluating pre-built edit catalogs or executing client implementation requests).

• Medicare & Regulatory Foundation: Expert understanding of core Medicare rules, billing regulations, Local/National Coverage Determinations (LCDs/NCDs), and NCCI edit logic across care settings.

• Multi-Setting Clinical & Facility Mastery: Deep working knowledge of facility and professional billing dynamics, including inpatient (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), outpatient/ASC (APC/OPPS, fee schedules), and professional CPT/HCPCS clinical guidelines.

• Hands-On Logic Writing: Direct experience authoring detailed rules and structural logic specifications for implementation in commercial claims editing engines (e.g., Optum/CES, Cotiviti, McKesson) or payer proprietary/internal rules platforms.

• Research & Data Literacy: Proven ability to synthesize complex clinical specialty guidelines into structured logic, paired with the analytical ability to read, interpret, and validate data queries (SQL assistance provided via modern AI tools).

• Senior-Level Influence: Exceptional narrative and framing skills with a track record of building cross-functional alignment around complex, original technical concepts.

Desired skills and experience:

• Specialized experience applying rules and coverage determinations specifically within a Medicare Advantage (MA) managed care environment.

• Familiarity with using AI workflows, large language models

PowerLines is a national nonprofit organization that aims to modernize the utility regulatory system for American energy consumers to lower utility bills and grow the economy. It focuses on state public utilities commissions (PUCs), which play a critical role in determining how much people pay for utility bills, how utilities invest in different types of energy, and where new energy projects are built. These 200 commissioners oversee more than $200 billion in utility spending each year and have significant influence over the future of our energy system.
Utility affordability is quickly becoming one of the most pressing economic challenges facing American consumers. In 2025, utilities requested a record-setting $31 billion in rate increases, double the previous record, while 80 million Americans are struggling to pay their utility bills. Meanwhile, the U.S. grid is experiencing the fastest rise in electricity demand in decades with the growth of AI data centers and manufacturing. Policymakers across the political spectrum are increasingly focused on how regulatory systems can respond to these pressures while protecting consumers and supporting economic growth.
Recognized on the 2025 “TIME100 Next” list, PowerLines is rapidly becoming a go-to source and leader in informing the national discussion of this issue and has already shaped the conversation in the New York Times, Washington Post, Wall Street Journal, Politico, Bloomberg, CBS News, NPR, Marketplace, Financial Times, TIME, Vox, The Daily Mail, and MIT Technology Review. PowerLines is quickly establishing credibility as a nonpartisan expert on utility regulatory and energy affordability issues while reaching a bipartisan set of policymakers, including initial partnerships with the National Governors Association and Western Governors Association.

This role will build the organization’s development strategy from the ground up and serve as a strategic partner to the Founder and Executive Director in expanding PowerLines ’ philanthropic base. The Director of Development will lead strategy and execution for major philanthropic support, with a focus on major gifts, family foundations, family offices, donor advised funds (DAFs), and high-net-worth (HNW) individuals. This is a rare opportunity for an experienced fundraiser to shape the financial foundation of a rapidly growing organization working on one of the most important economic issues facing American households. This role will serve as a force multiplier that enables PowerLines to expand its programs, shape policy, and improve energy affordability for consumers.
PowerLines is headquartered in Washington, DC. The Director of Development is a remote position, with travel of up to 30% expected. The Development Director will work closely with and report directly to the Founder and Executive Director.

You bring strong outpatient coding expertise along with hands-on experience in AR follow-up, denial resolution, and payment posting. You’re comfortable digging into claims, identifying issues, and following them through to resolution while maintaining accuracy and compliance. You communicate confidently with payors, patients, providers, and teammates, and you know how to make complex billing questions easier to understand. You thrive in a remote environment where you can take ownership of your work, manage competing priorities, and keep things moving. Most importantly, you care about getting it right - for our providers, our patients, and the business.
Who We Are
Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is building healthier communities by advancing primary care. We partner with patients, providers, and plans to provide personalized, local care for seniors in towns across America. We believe that patient needs come first, and that primary care is the foundation of patient-centric healthcare. With Oasis, patients receive better access and care. Providers receive the data, resources, and expertise to be successful in value-based care arrangements. Payors get the benefit of a solution that improves performance, drives growth, and reduces the total cost of care in hard-to-engage markets.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description:
About the Position

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.

At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges-large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment-that force us to search for novel techniques.

You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.

Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.

Solvd Cloud, Infra, Data & Security is growing fast, and our architecture leadership needs to keep up. We need someone who can take an unclear problem, define it, design the answer, and make sure it ships. You'll set technical direction across cloud, infrastructure, and data. You'll shape engagements and roadmaps before they're committed. And you'll stay close enough to delivery that what we design is what gets built. We operate AI-first: you'll use AI as a daily tool to move faster and multiply what you and the teams around you can deliver.

- The scope is broad on purpose. It covers cloud foundations, Kubernetes platforms, data, and AI workloads, so you won't be boxed into one layer.

You'll turn what works into repeatable patterns and prompts the team adopts. You'll also set the guardrails for how AI is used with client and production data.

- Security and compliance by design. You'll own IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and logging. Your designs need to hold up to SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulated-industry scrutiny without slowing delivery down.

- Cost and operability. Every design ships with a run cost, reliability targets, an observability plan, and a rollback path.

- Raising the bar. You'll run design reviews, mentor architects and senior engineers, and turn repeat solutions into reusable accelerators.

WHAT YOU BRING:

Have 12+ years in infrastructure, cloud, or data engineering, including several years as the accountable architect for production systems at scale.

title: Fiber Optic Product Engineer
description:
Amphenol Custom Cable is a leading provider of connectivity solutions with a strong national presence and global distribution network. Established in 1980, the company is a trusted partner to Fortune 500 organizations and is certified to TL9000:2008 and ISO 9001:2008 standards for excellence in manufacturing and installation connectivity services. Known for its rapid response, Amphenol Custom Cable delivers custom solutions that are efficient, cost-effective, and tailored to meet diverse customer needs. The company prides itself on providing quality, precision, and high performance for a wide range of requirements.
SUMMARY
The Product Development Engineer will prepare new fiber optic products for commercialization, provide and implement improvements for current manufacturing methods, and engage with existing customers to enhance user experience.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Will oversee fiber cable assembly engineering projects that are requested by the sales department (i.e., quotes, BOM creation, and new product request that can’t be configured on an online configuration tool).

• Create and manage Bill of Materials (BOM) and drawings for new and existing products using ERP management and 2D/3D modeling software such as AutoCad and SolidWorks.

• Lead and support the design, development, qualification, and improvement of fiber-optic products.

• Apply strong knowledge of optical fiber, fiber optic cables, connectors, splicing, coatings, and related components.

• Work with manufacturing to improve product performance, quality and cost.

• Develop engineering specifications, test procedures, technical documentation, and product requirements.

• Participate in new product introduction (NPI), design reviews, and engineering change processes.

• Review other engineering team members drawings and BOMs for accuracy.

• Responsible as the technical conduit between sales and engineering related to fiber optic cables, connectors, accessories, and/or assemblies.

• Will interface with customers (in conjunction with sales) to provide technical support during the sales development process (phone calls, customer site visits, trade shows, etc).

• Will work with engineering manager, fiber manufacturing engineer, and/or other departments to develop new products and solutions, as needed.

• Provide process documentation and operating instructions for new products introduced to the production team.

• Assist production to develop more efficient manufacturing procedures such as tooling, machinery, and processes and designing solutions to tackle those issues.

• Creatively solve problems and develop methodologies to increase margin on products.

• Collaborate with suppliers and external partners on materials, components, and product performance.

• Stay current with developments in fiber optic technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/industrial/electrical engineering/ manufacturing technology or equivalent; strong relevant experience in the fiber optic industry may be acceptable in lieu of degree.

• 8+ years of professional experience in fiber optics, optical communications or related industry.

• Strong technical understanding of fiber - optic cable assemblies.

• Experience with fiber-optic product development, testing and qualification.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills including root cause analysis.

• Ability to read and follow engineering and production documentation such as drawings, schematics, and process sheets.

• Willingness to gets hands-on with products and machinery and troubleshoot issues as they arise.

• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross functional engineering team.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with team members of different backgrounds.

• Working knowledge of software tools (MS Office, AutoCad, and SolidWorks), Proficiency in CAD is a plus.

• Assess governance, controls, documentation, supervisory practices, issue management, management information, and evidence of compliance against anticipated regulatory expectations.

title: Implementációs Szakértő E-commerce SAAS Területre
description:
Mi vagyunk a Base.com (vagy korábban BaseLinker), egy globális vállalat, ahol közösen fejlesztjük a Base SAAS alkalmazást. Ez a platform az e-commerce cégeket segíti a gyors növekedésben, költségcsökkentésben és hatékony működésben. Például több, mint 350 piactérhez tudjuk csatlakoztatni a webshopokat, automatizáljuk a rendeléskezelést, számlázást, ügyfélkommunikációt, vagy akár a raktári folyamatokat. És ez még csak a kezdet!
A közép-európai régióban piacvezetők vagyunk, több mint 35 000 elégedett ügyféllel.
Értesz az IT-hoz és a tech stackhez, átlátod a termék működését, tudod mi az a SAAS, képes vagy önállóan megoldani helyzeteket? Szereted mindezt kötetlenül, lokációtól függetlenül végezni? Akkor lehet, hogy megtaláltad a számodra álommelót!
Olyan tapasztalt kollégát keresünk, aki ügyfeleinkkel együttműködve végzi el a Base rendszer bevezetését és testreszabását az adott IT környezetre. Mivel a rendszerünk egy e-commerce ERP, amely több, mint 1700 integrációval dolgozik, gyakorlatilag nincs két egyforma implementáció.
Ebben a szerepben te leszel az, aki válaszol az ügyfelek kérdéseire, bevezeti és személyre szabja számukra a rendszert, segít az adatminőség kialakításában és eléri, hogy az ügyfél a végén tényleg elégedett legyen.
Feladatai:

• Ügyféltalálkozók, egyeztetések lebonyolítása a szerződéskötés után, az implementációhoz szükséges információk és adatok összegyűjtésére.

• Költség- és időbecslések készítése az ügyfél számára.

• A rendszer beállítása és testreszabása az egyedi igények alapján: adatbázisokkal, integrációkkal, kapcsolódó komponensekkel.

• Ha valami nem megoldható a meglévő funkciókkal, akkor alternatív lehetőségek keresése akár egy workaround, akár fejlesztési javaslat formájában.

• Hiányzó funkciók programozása (pl.: egyedi scriptek írása) az ügyfél igénye szerint.

• IT ticketek rögzítése, a szükséges új fejlesztésekhez.

• Folyamatos kapcsolattartás az ügyféllel, visszajelzések bekérése, jóváhagyások kezelése.

• A platform auditálása, működésének ellenőrzése.
Amit tőled várunk:

• Releváns tapasztalat imlementéció szakértői, e-commerce technológiai vagy egyéb, kapcsolódó területen (ERP bevezetés, PO/PM feladatok, fejlesztés).

• Hibátlan, anyanyelvi szintű magyar nyelvtudás, kommunikációképes angol nyelvismeret.Jártas vagy üzleti kommunikációban, projektmenedzsmentben és szoftverbevezetésben is, hiszen ezek adják a munkakör esszenciáját.

• Proaktív, megoldásorientált szemlélet és kitartás a feladatok teljes körű, sikeres lezárásáig.

• Tech stack ismeret, fejlesztési tapasztalat. Előnyt jelent a PHP ismerete.

• Pozitív hozzáállás másokhoz, önállóság és csapatban való együttműködés képessége.

• Elhivatottság, felelősségteljes hozzáállás, precizitás, valamint képesség hatékony távmunka végzésére.

Benefits

• Távmunka alapú együttműködést kínálunk (Slack, Zoom stb.-t hasznláunk a napi munkához),

• Rugalmas munkaidő és lokáció: te döntöd el, mikor és honnan dolgozol: otthonról, kávézóból, nyaralóból, vagy akár a tengerpartról.

• 2400 - 3200 EUR közötti havi díjazás, a tapasztalatod és képességeid alapján.

• Egy különleges projekt részese leszel, amit naponta több ezer cég használ és robbanásszerűen növekszik világszerte.

• Egy szuper csapat tagja lehetsz: ambiciózus, barátságos emberek, jó humorérzékkel és közös célokkal.

• Minden nap tanulhatsz valami újat, első kézből láthatod az e-commerce fejlődését.

• A további juttatásokban is rugalmasak vagyunk, mert számunkra a munkavállaló elégedettsége az alfa és az omega!

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.
As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.
Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Global Associate Manager, Food Safety
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our Global Food Safety team exists to keep Wolt’s operations safe, compliant, and trusted across every market we’re in. We partner closely with the business on growth and operational excellence initiatives, building customer trust through clear standards, data-driven improvements, and food safety programmes that actually hold up on the ground.

We’re looking for an Associate Manager, Food Safety to help us build and run these programmes across our European markets. You’ll work closely with operations, legal, policy, and frontline teams to protect our customers and partners, and to keep our sites compliant as we grow. Expect regular travel across our European locations.

What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on role that blends policy work with real, on-the-ground problem-solving. You’ll partner with country and area leaders, support external audits, and help translate global food safety standards into steps that actually work locally.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Partner with country and area leaders to manage food safety compliance and find pragmatic solutions to emerging risks.

• Support our external audit programme, coordinating schedules with third-party auditors and local food authorities.

• Help develop and maintain our global food safety policies, procedures, and HACCP plans, translating them into concrete steps at country level.

• Handle food safety issues, enquiries, and product recalls, guiding country and site teams through execution and customer communication.

• Work with Legal and Policy to keep us ahead of food safety regulations across our European markets.

• Track compliance metrics and use the data to spot trends and drive improvements

Our humble expectations* 

Formal food safety qualification (e.g. Food Science, Microbiology, Public Health), or equivalent hands-on experience.

• 5+ years of progressive food safety or regulatory compliance experience in hospitality, retail, quick commerce, or manufacturing.

• Strong working knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards such as FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, IFS, or BRC.

• Proven experience managing food safety programmes across multi-country, multi-unit operations, with a pragmatic, solutions-focused approach.

• Proven track record conducting internal/external audits, risk assessments, and gap analyses, with the ability to drive follow-up actions that deliver real compliance improvement.

• Experience implementing policies and procedures in response to new business initiatives or evolving risk environments.

• Fluent in English, given the multi-country scope of this role.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across our European markets.

What we offer

• The chance to build and shape food safety practices across a fast-growing set of European markets, with real ownership over how you get there.

• A seat on a collaborative, supportive global team genuinely invested in your growth as a leader.

• Cross-functional exposure - you’ll work directly with legal, policy, ops, and country teams, not from behind a desk.

This role is responsible for designing and scaling the frameworks, approvals, and processes that power how Temporal structures, prices, and closes complex commercial agreements - across all segments and geographies.

You'll bring a systems mindset to deal operations and a bias toward building scalable infrastructure - not just clearing the queue.

We're building a GTM Operations function that is AI-native from the ground up. We expect this leader to bring demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate deal structuring, review workflows, and commercial analysis - not as a future aspiration, but as a core part of how they work today.

- Own and scale the Global Deal Desk function, serving as the primary escalation path for non-standard deal structures, pricing exceptions, and complex approvals across all sales segments and geographies.

- Design and maintain deal approval workflows, pricing guardrails, discounting frameworks, and escalation policies that enable field teams to move quickly without creating downstream revenue or legal risk.

- Partner with Finance on revenue recognition implications of non-standard deal terms, multi-element arrangements, and usage-based constructs; escalate appropriately and maintain clean audit trails.

- Build and maintain Deal Desk playbooks, templates, and self-serve resources that reduce friction for AEs and reduce unnecessary escalations.

- Drive adoption and optimization of AI tools within Deal Desk workflows - including AI-assisted contract review, quote generation, deal-structuring support, and commercial analysis.

- Own Deal Desk reporting and analytics: deal velocity, exception rates, approval turnaround time, non-standard term frequency, and discount trends - surfacing insights to GTM and Finance leadership.

- Recruit, develop, and grow Deal Desk capacity as Temporal scales, including building team structure and operating norms for a globally distributed function.

- 7+ years of experience in Deal Desk, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, or a related commercial operations function, with direct ownership of deal structuring and approval workflows.

- Consumption-based business model expertise: proven experience designing or operationalizing Deal Desk processes for consumption, usage-based, or hybrid pricing models - including quoting ramp structures, commitment tiers, true-up mechanics, and the downstream revenue recognition implications of non-standard consumption constructs.

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Creative Director, Art to join our in-house creative team, focused on OpenAI’s business audiences. In this role, you’ll shape the visual direction and creative expression of our B2B brand across integrated campaigns, product launches, customer storytelling, and key industry moments.

You’ll help translate the capabilities of OpenAI’s technology into clear and compelling stories for business leaders, technical decision-makers, developers, and teams bringing AI into their organizations. The strongest work will make sophisticated products understandable without oversimplifying them-and connect what the technology can do with the real needs, ambitions, and outcomes of our customers.

You’ll partner closely with writers, designers, product marketers, sales and customer teams, product leaders, and external collaborators to develop big ideas and bring them to life across formats-from integrated campaigns and digital experiences to customer stories, films, events, and product storytelling.

- Create work that resonates across a range of audiences, including enterprise leaders, technical decision-makers, developers, and teams adopting AI

- Collaborate with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Communications, and Research to turn complex technology and customer insights into credible, differentiated creative work

- Build visual systems that can extend across the B2B customer journey, from awareness and product education to industry events and customer engagement

- Help evolve OpenAI’s visual language for business audiences in ways that are distinctive, scalable, and expressive while remaining connected to the broader brand

- Maintain a high bar for visual craft, conceptual thinking, and creative ambition, even when working within complex business or technical subject matter

- Lead multiple creative initiatives simultaneously with clarity, strong judgment, and creative conviction

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Manager, Valuation to lead and execute valuation analyses for private company investments, minority equity stakes, and other illiquid financial instruments held across the organization. This role will partner closely with Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR), Corporate Development, and the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee to ensure valuations are well-supported, defensible, and compliant with US GAAP (ASC 820, ASC 321/323) and SEC reporting requirements. This role reports into Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR) leadership and works closely with the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

Financial Modeling & Valuation Analysis

• Build and maintain complex financial models (DCF, comparable company/precedent transaction analyses, OPM/PWERM, Monte Carlo simulations) to support fair value measurements of private company investments and other illiquid holdings.

• Perform quarterly and event-driven valuations for private equity/venture-style investments, including waterfall/allocation analyses across complex capital structures (preferred stock, SAFEs, convertible notes, warrants).

• Develop and refine valuation methodologies in line with AICPA Private Equity and Venture Capital Valuation Guidelines.

Governance & Reporting

• Prepare valuation memos and supporting documentation for presentation to the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee and Audit Committee.

• Partner with TAFR to ensure valuation conclusions are properly reflected in consolidated financial statements and SEC disclosures (10-Q/10-K, 8-K as applicable).

• Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors (EY) on valuation-related audit requests, walkthroughs, and testing.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Collaborate with Corporate Development, Legal, and Investor Relations on new investment structuring, follow-on financings, and exit/liquidity events to assess valuation impacts.

• Advise on the accounting and valuation implications of new or complex investment structures (e.g., tiered/contingent consideration, equity-linked instruments).

Process & Controls

• Maintain and enhance internal controls (SOX) over the valuation process, including documentation standards, model governance, and data source validation.

• Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

• 10+ years of relevant experience in valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, or private equity/venture capital, with a focus on private company or illiquid investment valuation.

• Demonstrated expertise in building and auditing complex financial models (DCF, comparable company analysis, option pricing models, waterfall/allocation models).

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP fair value measurement guidance (ASC 820) and its application to private investments.

• Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting valuation conclusions to committees, auditors, or senior stakeholders.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel/financial modeling; familiarity with valuation software or platforms a plus.
